title: Non-degeneracy of the standard symplectic form
statement:
Fix a prime $p$ and an integer $n$, and let $V = \bbf_p^n \times \bbf_p^n$ carry the bilinear form
\[
\omega\big((x,z),(x',z')\big) \;=\; \sum_{i=1}^{n}\big(x_i z'_i - z_i x'_i\big)
\]
over the prime field $\bbf_p$. Then $\omega$ is non-degenerate: the only vector $u \in V$ with $\omega(u,v) = 0$ for every $v \in V$ is $u = 0$.
hypotheses_covered: p is prime (F_p is a field)
the form is the standard symplectic pairing on F_p^n × F_p^n
replaced: The bundled symplectic form $\mathrm{symB}$ is non-degenerate.
